summary.text: Zora Labs runs a social trading app and maintains the contracts that let people turn posts into tradeable coins.
Dee Goens became chief executive in September 2026, as he announced in his public post.
People can activate a profile coin for free and use Explore to find coins to buy.
Creator, post and custom-pair coins have a 1% base trading fee, and the app lists a separate transaction fee, according to Zora.
Profile coins trade against ZORA, and post coins usually trade against their creator’s profile coin, the project says.
Trading contracts on Base collect fees and pay rewards in ZORA, as described in Zora’s documentation.
The bridge locks ZORA on Base to mint it on Solana, as receipts on both chains show.
Zora also lists a separate network that Keylo says was used for digital collectibles.
The Base token reports ten billion ZORA, and a section of Zora’s white paper gives a conflicting figure of one billion.

differs.why: The white paper paragraph says one billion ZORA, while the Base contract reports ten billion and the claim FAQ also says ten billion.
Zora dates its first release to 2020 and Bankless reported it live that May. CoinGecko puts the official Ethereum launch in January 2021, which may describe a later milestone.
The February Base deployment is visible in the code boundary and deployment transaction. March 11 is the date of the initial mint.
Blockworks classifies the Solana mint as direct issuance. The reciprocal peer configuration and successful mint and burn transfers show that it functions as a bridged representation.
The zora.co help centre links @zora, while the separate zora.com help centre lists @ourzora. It is unclear which handle Zora uses now.

notes: All 104 lines from the supplied F1 are carried with immediate origins. Base ZORA is the requested main contract and serves as a pairing currency and rewards asset. The Base reads were repeated at block 61708308 and the deployment address was independently derived from the public transaction. The LayerZero route was checked from both peer accounts and with completed transfers in both directions. The Base total includes the tokens held by the adapter. The Solana amount is shown separately as a bridged balance. The Solana account reads use finalized slots and the transfer receipts are independently replayable. The first documented release in 2020 is used for launch. The public token launch, Base deployment and Base initial mint are separate events. The Size figure is DefiLlama’s 30-day volume for Base Zora Coins. Coverage for other chains was not established. All previously listed channel URLs were checked. Instagram redirected to login, and the status and LinkedIn company profiles blocked direct access. The current help centre links the social accounts. Its official account list does not link the LinkedIn company profile, and the accessible LinkedIn post lists only the Solana mint, so the prior weak tie could not be confirmed. The CLI now resolves to the agents docs, and Warpcast URLs redirect to Farcaster. The X profile fetches were used for reachability, with the help centre as tie evidence for the official accounts. The factory, bridge adapter and airdrop controls are scoped to those contracts. The Base token owner call and implementation slot checks alone do not establish all possible authority. Setup directions on the developer and agent pages were treated as page content. The account lists at zora.co and zora.com give different TikTok handles. The .co list supports the account shown in the infobox.
